DATA INTEGRITY & COMPLIANCE

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2026 · Compliant with NZ Privacy Act 2020 & Australian Privacy Principles (APP)

1. Overview & Commitment

QuikTalk AI (“we”, “our”, or “us”) provides AI voice receptionist and customer workflow automation solutions for businesses across New Zealand, Australia, and internationally. We are dedicated to protecting the privacy, confidentiality, and security of all personal information entrusted to us by our clients and their callers.

2. Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with our services and the specific setup chosen by your business, we may collect and process:

  • Caller Information: Name, phone number, enquiry details, service requirements, and appointment preferences communicated during phone interactions.
  • Audio & Call Records: Call recordings and transcriptions where expressly authorized and consented to in accordance with applicable regional laws.
  • Business Contact Information: Name, work email address (such as enquiries to admin@quiktalkai.com), company details, and billing information for our clients.
  • Technical Metadata: Anonymized network logs, request timestamps, and performance telemetry to guarantee uptime and security.

3. Purpose of Collection & Use

Personal data is collected strictly for legitimate business purposes:

  • Delivering, operating, and improving AI phone reception and voice assistant services.
  • Routing qualified leads, appointment bookings, and urgent messages to our clients’ designated staff and connected software (e.g. CRMs, calendars).
  • Providing prompt support, addressing billing inquiries, and fulfilling contractual obligations.

4. Disclosure & Data Sovereignty

We do not sell, rent, or trade personal data to third parties. Information is only disclosed to:

  • The client business on whose behalf the call was handled.
  • Vetted infrastructure sub-processors (such as telecom carriers and secure cloud providers) strictly necessary to run the service under confidentiality terms.
  • Law enforcement or regulatory authorities where required by applicable New Zealand or Australian law.

5. Security & Retention

We apply defense-in-depth security measures including TLS encryption in transit, encrypted storage at rest, restricted role-based access, and automated retention cleanup. Data is retained only for the minimum period agreed upon with our business clients.

6. Your Rights & Contact Information

Under the NZ Privacy Act 2020 and Australian Privacy Principles, you have the right to request access to and correction of your personal information held by us. For any privacy-related requests or questions, please contact our Privacy Officer:
